maria: Quick postmortem follow-up: we need owners + ETAs for fixes, a statuspage blurb that aligns with Legal, and a plan for customer-facing summaries and RCA sharing. Also saw a recurrence signal for 'cache-prime race' across services. Can owners confirm?
aj: I can take the statuspage publish task once we have final copy and Legal ok.
sam: I'll write the customer-facing incident summary and a redactable RCA skeleton. Target: Tue EOD (1835096400). Will leave redaction placeholders.
emily: I'll own the engineering remediation for cache-prime race. Root cause looks like concurrent init + TTL refresh. Plan: add init mutex + stricter TTL validation, then canary. ETA: Mon morning (1835040000).
maria: Emily, please post canary gating thresholds so Ops can verify before wide rollout.
emily: Canary gating: 95th latency <= baseline+12% for 24h on canary subset, error spike <0.3%. If green, 10%->30%->100% rollout with 1h observation windows.
kate: Legal here: avoid absolute promises. Prefer "anticipated" or "expected". For RCAs, we require customer consent + redaction signoff before sending any customer-specific info. I'll post the redaction template link.
devon: @ops-bot did a recurrence sweep and flagged a pattern across multiple incidents. Recommend a focused recurrence review with SRE + Eng-ML next week.
ops-bot: incident-audit-bot: recurrence detected: cache-prime-race (4 events last 150 days). Related incidents: 1811112222, 1822223333, 1840001111, 1759998888. Recommend scheduling recurrence retro.
zara: For the customer note, can we add action items customers can expect (e.g., "we will provide a redactable RCA on request") so they know how to get more detail?
sam: Good call. Draft line for statuspage/customer note: ```We are rolling a targeted mitigation to address cache initialization races that affected a subset of requests. We anticipate progressive improvement over 48-72 hours. A redactable incident summary and RCA will be available; customers may request a detailed RCA subject to redaction and consent.```
kate: Edit suggestion: change "anticipate" -> "are anticipating" and include the redaction form link. Also add a short sentence about how to request a scoped RCA.
aj: New statuspage draft (will publish after Sam+Legal finalize): ```Partial degradation due to cache initialization races affecting a subset of requests. Mitigation is in progress; service performance is anticipated to improve over 48-72 hours. More details and a redactable RCA will be posted when available.```
maria: Action items recap (I'll add to the tracker): Emily -> remediation + canary gating (ETA Mon 1835040000). Sam -> customer summary + redactable RCA draft (ETA Tue EOD 1835096400). Aj -> publish statuspage after Legal signoff. Kate -> confirm redaction template & consent flow. Devon -> set up recurrence review with SRE+Eng-ML (by next Wed). Zara -> reviewer for customer note copy (optional). I'll update https://tracker.redwood/incidents/1835009999 and sweep Friday.
ops-bot: workflow-bot: action tracker updated by maria.
maria: Please keep replies in this thread so I can capture final commits. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
